title: WeaveView
description: Cluster-scoped operational weave projection: placement/coverage/capacity folded per-shard → per-node → per-cluster. Each lens field is optional — a facing carries only the lenses it selected (the not-selected-field contract). Operational Category C — no DHT entry; projection only.

placementGapCount.description: Number of open shard placement gaps (under-replicated shards) at the time of measurement.

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which this view was assembled.

rsCoverage.description: Mean RS contract-coverage across open placement gaps. 1.0 when there are no gaps (fully covered). Optional — absent when the lens was not selected.

clusterCapacity.description: Aggregated storage capacity across all custodian nodes. Optional — absent when no custodian metrics are available.

free.description: Bytes available across all nodes. null when no node has reported a current sample.

used.description: Bytes occupied by blob storage across all nodes. null when no node has reported a current sample.

stewarded.description: Bytes committed via REA custody-blob commitments. null when no custody rows exist.

tierOccupancy.description: Risk-tier occupancy distribution (deferred — Slice 5 follow-on). Absent in Slice 4 responses.

regionOccupancy.description: Regional occupancy distribution (deferred — Slice 5 follow-on). Absent in Slice 4 responses.
